name: CI - Spring Boot Test
on: pull_request: push: branches: - main - develop
jobs: test: runs-on: [self-hosted, windows] defaults: run: working-directory: synctrip
steps: - name: Checkout source uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK 17 uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: temurin java-version: '17' cache: gradle
- name: Run unit tests shell: powershell run: .\gradlew.bat clean test --no-daemon

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jdk AS build WORKDIR /app
# Copy Gradle wrapper and build metadata first for better layer caching COPY gradlew gradlew.bat settings.gradle build.gradle ./ COPY gradle ./gradle RUN chmod +x ./gradlew
# Copy source code and build the boot jar COPY src ./src RUN ./gradlew clean bootJar --no-daemon
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/build/libs/*.jar app.jar EXPOSE 8080 ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]
